summary: Comprehensive architectural blueprint and implementation plan for the Trimming Production, Inventory, Quality Control & Cost Management System. Covers technology stack, Firestore schema, inventory transaction engine, PTN/OGP/IGP lifecycles, production planning for WS-01..WS-70, QC & rework loops, vendor payment ledgers in PKR, employee labour cost allocation, unit costing, monthly stocktaking reconciliation, barcode/QR integration, and phased delivery.
